description: The axis registry (AES-V2.2 / SUE-560). Editorial Intent (schemas/editorial-intent.schema.json) resolves over independent axes; this file is the map from an axis id to where its profiles live and which intent field it fills. Adding a transformation, audience, surface, artifact class, brand, or reference profile means adding a JSON file under the matching `dir` — never editing scripts/lib/profile-core.mjs or any router. See docs/architecture/V2-EDITORIAL-LEARNING-CORE.md §3 and §7.

axes.owns: Evidence burden, required fields, register, and artifact fit per content type.
What a transformation from source to output may change and what it must preserve.
Who is on the other end, expressed as concrete text/visual/audio delivery adjustments.

Per-language quality authority: which external bodies are normative for the language, which empirical native/genre/audience traits it asserts, and how domain terms are rendered. Schema: schemas/language-pack.schema.json. The language-agnostic methodology these packs plug into is docs/architecture/LANGUAGE-QUALITY-ARCHITECTURE.md and is never duplicated into a pack.
axes.filename_rule: BCP-47-style id as the filename stem: ko-KR -> ko-KR.json
axes.planned_note: ko-KR is the only pack. A second language reuses the methodology and inherits none of Korean's phenomena; no locale profile is created before there is evidence it differs from an existing one. Portability here is architectural, not a multi-language framework built in advance of a second language existing.

axes.owns: Where the piece lands, who owns that destination, and what constraint that puts on the Core.
Which medium and which shape of it — visual/audio artifact profiles, brand tokens, prompt compilation.
axes.filename_rule: namespaced id, "/" written as "-" in the filename: visual/thumbnail -> visual-thumbnail.json
axes.planned_note: Declared but not yet built. text/* artifact profiles are an open integration item — V1 already defines artifact kinds in schemas/artifact.schema.json and schemas/ARTICLE-ARTIFACT-CONTRACT.md records how a kind relates to a profile, so text profiles must extend that layering rather than duplicate it. A cross-reference to a planned id is reported, never silently accepted, and never treated as a typo. audio/* landed with AES-V2.8 (SUE-566).
axes.deferred_note: Video artifact profiles are out of V2 scope. VIDEO-STORYBOARD.md remains the V1 editorial authority; no machine profile is planned until a real video need exists.

axes.owns: Visual/voice brand tokens applied by artifact profiles. Not an editorial-intent axis field; referenced from artifact profiles.
axes.filename_rule: versioned: <brand-id>.v<major>.json — the version lives in the filename so an old brand profile is never overwritten in place

axes.owns: Modality-aware craft-reference evaluation and selection rules. Never grants factual authority (see docs/architecture/V2-EDITORIAL-LEARNING-CORE.md §2).
